name: Prefix array built in the constructor
time: O(n) once, then O(1) per call
whenToUse: The standard answer whenever the array does not change and many range sums are asked: pay O(n) once, then every query is one subtraction.

card.signals: "handle multiple queries" on an array that never changes ("Immutable"), each query asks for the sum of nums[left..right].
card.pattern: a prefix array. The constructor builds pre once; sumRange answers with pre[right + 1] − pre[left]. O(n) once, then O(1) per call.
card.coreIdea: pre[right + 1] is the sum of nums[0..right] and pre[left] is the sum of nums[0..left − 1]. Their difference is exactly nums[left..right].
card.variant: exclusive prefix sum with a sentinel: pre has n + 1 slots and pre[0] = 0. That is why left = 0 needs no special case. This is the base form of the pattern for range-sum queries.

invariant: pre[k] = nums[0] + … + nums[k − 1] for every written slot k.

legend.text: left: first index of the range
right: last index of the range
the cells read in this step
nums[left..right] and the two pre cells that give its sum
